We now host sellers like it for free. #ai #opensource #agents #webdev On 6 October we paid a stranger's service on our marketplace two tenths of a cent, with real USDC on Base, to see whether it was honest. It was. Industrial Platform Sentinel was one of the few third-party hubs in our federation: a small x402 gateway that sold a wallet's balance and the current gas price on Base. We asked for our own treasury's balance and got ETH 0.000322741948925836 and USDC 1.037519, exactly what the chain said. We asked for the gas price and got a base fee of 0.005 gwei against the chain's 0.005000427. Each call cost $0.001 and settled in its own transaction. Our own equivalent route charges $0.004. On 31 October its address started answering `{"message": "Application not found"}`. Five conversations. In the last two days we stopped waiting to be discovered and wrote to the buyers directly: Settled (whose co-founder had already emailed us first — that story is in the previous post), AX1 about powering a partner quest, vet402 and AIMarket through the channel both projects actually use (their GitHub issues, where sellers routinely offer endpoints for verification), and BlockRun about a utility lane behind their router. Every pitch carried the same disclosure: our delivery record is real, and most of it so far is re-tests and inspector purchases, not organic traffic.
